mapper.sql: id, comment_id, sentiment_score, sentiment_label, positive_words, negative_words, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_sentiment (comment_id, sentiment_score, sentiment_label, positive_words, negative_words, update_time) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{sentimentScore}, #{sentimentLabel}, #{positiveWords}, #{negativeWords}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT co.id as courseId, co.name as courseName, co.img as courseImg, COUNT(*) as commentCount, ROUND(AVG(cs.sentiment_score), 4) as avgScore, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.sentiment_label = '正面' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positiveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.sentiment_label = '负面' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negativeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.sentiment_label = '中性' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as neutralCount FROM comment_sentiment cs LEFT JOIN comment c ON cs.comment_id = c.id LEFT JOIN course co ON c.course_id = co.id WHERE co.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY co.id, co.name, co.img HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY avgScore DESC LIMIT #{limit}
